title: Verification
intro: Confirm the profile is yours with a quick selfie. Verification earns you a trust badge and helps others see you’re a real person.
framingHint: Position your face in the frame
privacyNote: The selfie is used only for verification and won’t appear on your profile.

camera.captureFailed: Couldn’t take the selfie. Try again.
camera.permission: We need the camera to take your verification selfie. Without access, verification can’t be done.
camera.permissionBlocked: Camera access is turned off. Open Settings, enable the camera for FLIRT, then come back to verification.

reasons.no_match: We couldn’t confirm it’s you. Make sure your face is clearly visible and well lit, and that your profile photos show your face. You can try again.
reasons.no_face: We didn’t find a face in the selfie. Hold the phone at eye level, fit your whole face in the frame, then try again.
reasons.invalid_image: The selfie couldn’t be read. Try taking another one, with better light.
reasons.too_large: The selfie is too large to upload. Try again.
reasons.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and come back.
reasons.no_profile: You need a profile with photos before verifying. Complete your profile, then come back.
reasons.unavailable: The verification service isn’t responding right now. It’s not your fault — try again in a few minutes.
reasons.network: Connection lost. Check your internet and try again.
